owner_decisions.windows_distribution: Online installation is sufficient. A standalone offline installer is outside the selected support scope.

published_baseline.reason: The published Windows IDE reserved an approved catalog revision. Run remained disabled on that reservation and the published client had no native launch method.

services.observation: The installed public client launched the native root on the current worker. In the three-node KinD cohort ten native Jobs overlapped for 11.678054 s and twenty authenticated observers saw every completion. One of 100 separate native starts won; 99 returned conflict. Individual receipts identify the cluster and source. During a private GENERIC simulator outage, the interrupted native telemetry read was persisted UNCERTAIN. The request remained unchanged for 6.434 seconds after restoration. The affected procedure caught its driver error and reported FINISHED while its worker exited 1 and retained its reservation. A second worker progressed during the outage and exited 0. No commands were issued.
services.remaining: Complete the outstanding Listener partition, multi-Context isolation and concurrent alias/version cases on the supported deployment.

Both original hours were skipped when their prerequisites failed. On the independently run review tree, growth was 296.55 and 300.16 MiB, again with zero swap. The embedded worker sources and original measurement code match the frozen runtime.

ide_browser.observation: On the frozen delivery pair, the original native root and child remained paused across explicit A to B to A handoffs and reconnect. Twenty additional Chromium observers saw FINISHED. B answered the original question once and stale controller and observer commands returned 403. Both vendor-host processes loaded the verified JetBrains ZIP. The frozen pair also passed installed Windows prompt and two-user Git conflict, as well as native Step, Pause, Continue and Abort through the browser. The authenticated Windows Reserve and Refresh actions returned 503 when the dedicated client relay was stopped. Local Run and Debug remained disabled, both shortcuts and handlers triggered zero local starts, and the positive-control script left its guarded path untouched. An explicit refresh recovered the same remote execution.
ide_browser.remaining: The user must complete JetBrains onboarding in IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm so the project-level Run and Debug checks can run. Remaining browser request/reject/expiry and multi-panel contracts need complete coverage.

kubernetes.observation: The local enforcing three-node KinD cluster admitted one of 100 full native requests. Ten Jobs finished across two worker nodes. A new authority on the same PVC retained the paused root in RECOVERY_REQUIRED after the original authority and worker were independently fenced. Calico policy decisions and actual node-runtime observations are recorded. A dedicated KinD worker node went offline for 54.61 seconds during native execution. The public record stayed STARTING/OWNED until the operator suspended the job and fenced its old authority. The observer then saw RECOVERY_REQUIRED. All 17 original audit events and the partial ASRUN survived when the same node returned. The retired worker and stale controller were denied, and the native job did not restart.
kubernetes.remaining: Provide a representative cluster and operator. Complete multi-host partitions and drains, admission, storage recovery, upgrade and rollback there. The observed node-off, fence and return used a single workstation.
command_or_ci_run: cluster.py, deploy.py, run.py, single.py, fence.py and verify_template.py
